[[Page 139 STAT. 420]]
SEC. 4. <<NOTE: 12 USC 5903.>>  REQUIREMENTS FOR ISSUING PAYMENT
                    STABLECOINS.

    (a) Standards.--
            (1) In general.--An issuer shall--
                    (A) maintain reserves; and
                    (B) publish monthly reports.
[[Page 139 STAT. 421]]
            (2) Prohibition on rehypothecation.--Reserves may not be
        pledged.
    (b) Other.--Text.
SEC. 5. APPROVAL.
    (a) In general.--Approved.
